spacr.qt.ai.providers.explain_failure.label: spacr.qt.ai.providers.explain_failure#1
spacr.qt.ai.providers.explain_failure.source: spaCR AI (free) asks the relay's ``/diagnose`` with the anonymised summary and :data:`spacr.crashreport.EXPLAIN_QUESTION`; a vendor CLI answers :func:`spacr.crashreport.ai_summary_prompt` here (:func:`write_report_summary`). The same text is shown in the console and sent as the report's ``ai_summary``, so a failure costs one AI call. Blocks, so call it off the GUI thread.

spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summa.label: spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summary#0
spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summa.source: Have the user's own AI summarise an anonymised report, or return ``""``.
spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summa.context: Have the user's own AI summarise an anonymised report, or return ``""``.

spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summa.label: spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summary#1
spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summa.source: The provider is given :func:`spacr.crashreport.ai_summary_prompt` and nothing else. It runs on a thread of its own and is stopped after ``timeout`` seconds; a failure, a timeout or an empty answer gives ``""``, and the report is then filed without a summary. Blocks, so call it off the GUI thread.
spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summa.context: The provider is given :func:`spacr.crashreport.ai_summary_prompt` and nothing else. It executes on an independent execution path of its own and is stopped after ``timeout`` seconds; a failure, a timeout or an empty answer gives ``""``, and the report is then filed without a summary. Blocks, so call it off the main GUI execution path.

spacr.qt.ai.providers.write_report_summa.context: the summary text, scrubbed and cut to :data:`spacr.crashreport.MAX_AI_SUMMARY_CHARS`.
